text:
Maria S.: Hey team — Oakbridge legal asked for our SOC 2 report and wants an NDA + a short acknowlegement letter while SOC2 Type II is being finalized. Can we move fast on this?
Alex K.: We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II extract behind an NDA. Need to confirm which controls they actually need access to (security/availability mostly?).
Sam R.: Oakbridge is specifically asking to see access control + change management sections for the POC. They want a signed NDA first, then temporary access to a redacted PDF or a time-limited S3 link.
Jen L.: I can sign off on the standard mutual NDA template but legal wants the customer to use our standard redaction process. If they insist on a full report we need a bridge acknowledgement that the final report is pending (expected end of Q2).
Maria S.: Timeline: Oakbridge wants to close the PO next week, POC starts immediately after. Is a redacted upload + signed NDA acceptable for sales to proceed?
Alex K.: Yes — from security's side: signed NDA + documented request is enough for redacted extracts. Prefer we issue a short "SOC 2 acknowledgement" PDF that says report under review and provides redacted controls. That avoids sending raw internal artifacts.
Jen L.: I'll prepare the acknowledgement text. Draft will be: short statement of receipt, confirmation that final SOC 2 Type II is pending, list of controls included in the extract, and instruction to return/delete copies after review. Can someone confirm signatory?
Sam R.: Oakbridge will sign as "Oakbridge Inc." — contact is Jordan Lee (jordan@oakbridge.com). They want DocuSign.
doc-bot: Uploaded: /secure/soc2/Oakbridge-extract-2025-redacted.pdf (access: restricted, expires 72h) :lock: :information_source:
Alex K.: For the extract we should remove user-level logs and customer data, keep control descriptions and evidence summaries. Security will do redaction pass and watermark the PDF "CONFIDENTIAL - FOR EVALUATION ONLY".
Jen L.: NDA sent via DocuSign to Jordan just now. I used our mutual NDA template with an added clause for ephemeral access and redaction acknowledgement.
Maria S.: Great — once signed, Sam can share the doc-bot link with Jordan and we can run the POC onboarding. Any objections to expedited flow?
Alex K.: No objections, just confirm that the extract does not include operational logs or screenshots with customer data.
Sam R.: Confirmed. I'll attach the POC scope doc and rollback playbook after NDA countersigned.
Jen L.: If Oakbridge requests anything beyond the redacted extract, escalation to Legal + Security required.
Maria S.: Thanks all. I'll update the CRM with NDA status and expected SOC2 deliverable timeline. :thumbsup:
